claim: The revised EU FDI screening framework was adopted as Regulation (EU) 2026/1386 of 17 June 2026, repealing Regulation (EU) 2019/452, and published in the Official Journal on 26 June 2026.
evidence: EUR-Lex: "on the screening of foreign investments in the Union and repealing Regulation (EU) 2019/452 ... Done at Strasbourg, 17 June 2026."; HK TID circular: "Regulation (EU) 2026/1386 was published on 26 June 2026" (para 1)

claim: Regulation (EU) 2026/1386 entered into force on 16 July 2026 and applies from 17 January 2028, with certain articles applying from 16 July 2026.
evidence: HK TID: "The Regulation will enter into force on 16 July 2026 and apply from 17 January 2028, except that certain Articles will apply from 16 July 2026." (para 4); EUR-Lex final article: "However, Article 3(2), Article 15(2), Article 18(1) to (6), Article 18(9) to (12), and Articles 27, 28 and 29 shall apply from 16 July 2026."

claim: Regulation (EU) 2026/1386 sets a common minimum sectoral scope of foreign investments subject to mandatory prior authorisation in all member states that includes semiconductors.
evidence: "It establishes a common minimum sectoral scope for investments subject to mandatory prior authorisation, which covers defence and dual-use items, semiconductors, artificial intelligence, strategic raw materials and financial services, etc." (HK TID circular 554/2026, para 2)

claim: Rapidus reports that on 27 February 2026 it completed a 267.6 billion yen funding round: 100 billion yen from Japan's Information-technology Promotion Agency (IPA) and 167.6 billion yen from 32 private companies.
evidence: "Rapidus Corporation today announced that it has completed a funding round totaling 267.6 billion yen ... A total of 100 billion yen was invested from the Information-Technology Promotion Agency (IPA)"; "private-sector funding, totaling 167.6 billion yen from 32 companies" (Rapidus news, 27 Feb 2026)

metric.name: Rapidus funding round size
metric.population: Equity raised by Rapidus Corporation: IPA (100) plus 32 private companies (167.6)

claim: Rapidus reports that on 5 June 2026 it completed an additional 150 billion yen funding round from the IPA, bringing its stated capital and legal capital surplus to 424.95 billion yen.
evidence: "completed an additional funding round of 150 billion yen (equivalent to $943 million USD) from the Information-Technology Promotion Agency (IPA)"; "As a result of this latest capital increase by the IPA, Rapidus funding now totals 424.95 billion yen." (Rapidus news, 5 Jun 2026)

metric.population: Equity investment by IPA in Rapidus Corporation

claim: South Korea's Cabinet approved the enforcement decree of the Special Act on Strengthening and Supporting the Competitiveness of the Semiconductor Industry on 4 August 2026, and the Act and decree took effect on 11 August 2026.
evidence: Korea Herald (4 Aug 2026): "enforcement rules approved by the Cabinet on Tuesday"; "The decree for the country's special semiconductor law will take effect Aug. 11, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources said." MLex: "allowing both the act and the decree to take effect simultaneously on Aug. 11 as scheduled"
notes: Follow-up to CLM-0355. Ministry statement itself not read.

claim: On 29 July 2026 the US Department of Commerce announced letters of intent with 7 companies for USD 874 million of CHIPS R&D incentives, with a minority, non-controlling government equity stake in each company as a condition of the funds.
evidence: "The Department of Commerce today announced the signing of 7 letters of intent to provide $874 million in federal incentives under the CHIPS and Science Act."; "The Department will receive a minority, non-controlling equity stake in each company as a condition for receiving the funds" (NIST news, 29 Jul 2026)
